columns.rationale: invoice has null_rate 0.0 (null_count 0) across 2330 distinct values, with samples like '489434' and '489435' showing numeric-string invoice identifiers, so it stays VARCHAR.
stockcode has null_rate 0.0 across 3141 distinct values, including alphanumeric codes such as '10002R' and '10123C', so it must remain text rather than a numeric type.
description has null_rate 0.005041 (228 of 45228 rows null) across 3045 distinct free-text values like ' 3 STRIPEY MICE FELTCRAFT', so it stays nullable text.
quantity is landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0, min -1395.0 and max 5184.0, and every sample (-1395.0, -1043.0, -1012.0, ...) is a whole number, so it casts safely to INTEGER.
quantity samples include negative whole numbers down to -1395.0, indicating cancellation/return lines, so is_return is derived as quantity < 0 for consumers to filter.
invoicedate has null_rate 0.0 and every sample ('2009-12-01 07:45:00', ...) is an ISO-shaped timestamp string, so it is renamed to snake_case invoice_date and cast to TIMESTAMP.
price has null_rate 0.0, min 0.0, max 1998.49, and samples (0.04, 0.06, 0.08, ...) show consistent two-decimal currency values, so DECIMAL(10,2) fits.

customer_id has null_rate 0.29778 (13468 of 45228 rows null), with integral samples (12346.0, 12349.0, ...) ranging 12346.0 to 18287.0, so it casts to INTEGER but stays nullable given the high null rate.
country has null_rate 0.0 across 24 distinct values including 'Australia', 'Austria', 'Belgium', so it remains required text.
is_airbyte_metadata is true for _airbyte_raw_id, a capture-tool UUID column with 45228 distinct values and no business meaning, so it is dropped.
is_airbyte_metadata is true for _airbyte_extracted_at, a capture-time timestamp with only 2 distinct values, so it is dropped as pipeline metadata.
is_airbyte_metadata is true for _airbyte_meta, which has a single distinct value '{}' and carries no business content, so it is dropped.

decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.011188 across row_count 45228, indicating roughly 506 fully duplicate rows that should be removed before grain enforcement.

invoice (2330 distinct), stockcode (3141 distinct), and invoice_date (2004 distinct) together plausibly identify a single order line after exact duplicates are removed, since invoice alone repeats across multiple stockcodes per order.
customer_id has null_rate 0.29778 (13468 of 45228 rows), reflecting guest or unidentified checkouts, so nulls are retained rather than imputed or failed.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are all flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and carry no business meaning, so all three are dropped.
quantity is landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sample value from -1395.0 to 5184.0 is a whole number, so it casts to INTEGER.
quantity samples include negative whole numbers (min -1395.0), so is_return is derived as quantity < 0 to flag cancellation/return lines for consumers.
price is landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but samples (0.04, 0.06, 0.08, ...) show consistent two-decimal currency values ranging 0.0 to 1998.49, so it casts to DECIMAL(10,2).

purpose: This table provides a cleaned, deduplicated line-item view of online retail invoices, feeding downstream sales and returns analytics.
usage: Consumers should filter is_return = true when computing gross sales, treat customer_id nulls as unidentified or guest purchases, and rely on the invoice/stockcode/invoice_date grain for joins and aggregation.
limitations: Roughly 1.1% of bronze rows were exact duplicates and are dropped; customer_id remains null for about 30% of rows and cannot be backfilled; description retains a small null rate (0.5%) that consumers should handle as missing text.
